title: B3 fix round: scorecard counts only execute tasks (review T-0031)
spec:
Why: review T-0031 on B3 commit 1b5a17f (full text: /Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/.orchestrator/tasks/T-0031.json). scorecard.build() aggregates every task json; spawn.run_worker stamps review_verdict on both the review task and the reviewed task, and review tasks have no executor field, so key_of() buckets them as claude:<tier> (tier defaults to sonnet) — request_changes is double-counted and review/scout/challenge tasks pollute executor rows.

What (2 files: orchestrator/scorecard.py, tests/test_orchestrator.py; this worktree branches from task/T-0018):
1. build(): only tasks with role == "execute" contribute to per-executor counts (merged, failed, rounds, review_request_changes, by_complexity); runs jsonl lines are filtered to role == "execute" as well for the executor scorecard (scout/review runs still count under `by="tier"` if that mode exists; otherwise ignore them). key_of() for an execute task without an executor field returns f"claude:{tier}" as before.
2. tests: a review task json with review_verdict=request_changes and tier sonnet alongside one execute task executed by claude:sonnet with review_verdict=request_changes → build()["claude:sonnet"]["review_request_changes"] == 1; a scout run line in runs jsonl does not create an executor row.

Run `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py`. Commit: "scorecard: aggregate execute tasks only; no double count of review verdicts (review T-0031)" with a revert-path body.
acceptance: uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py exits 0 with the new double-count regression test
build() ignores review/scout/challenge tasks and runs for executor rows
git diff --stat limited to orchestrator/scorecard.py and tests/test_orchestrator.py

result.summary:
Committed as `815af4d`.

**Summary:** `scorecard.build()` was bucketing review/scout/challenge tasks and runs under `claude:<tier>` (since they lack an `executor` field), which double-counted `review_request_changes` and mixed non-execute work into executor rows. Fixed by skipping any task or run whose `role` isn't `"execute"` in the default (`by="executor"`) view; `by="tier"` still counts all runs.

**Files changed:** `orchestrator/scorecard.py`, `tests/test_orchestrator.py`

**Test output:** `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py` → 50 tests, OK (no failures). `tests-green.sh` gate → exit 0.

Revert path: `git revert 815af4d`.
